listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Wii U) — BOTWRecomp (vasist15-source) (vasist15-source)
listing.original_game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Wii U)
listing.summary: The project reports the intro, Great Plateau, NPCs, audio, movies, saving and DLC at 30 FPS on an M4 Air. Shader stutter and lighting glitches remain. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA base game 00050000101C9400 and update 0005000E101C9400 v208. U-King.rpx must match SHA-256 ba58da5b95ce929e005d058ceb08b9b2788d1ab2bbc8a6c189bbadca0bb34d30. DLC 0005000C101C9400 is optional and must be your own.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the release DMG installer to build the app locally from your own dump. The project estimates about five minutes; original game files remain required.

warnings: The project reports the intro, Great Plateau, NPCs, audio, movies, saving and DLC at 30 FPS on an M4 Air. Shader stutter and lighting glitches remain.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
